name: Mara Fenwick
blurb: Three championships in and she's still tabling an axe on turn two. People have learned not to block her Kor Skyfisher — usually the hard way.

name: Oyelaran Dosunmu
blurb: Founding member. Wrote the club's first sideboard guide on the back of a beer mat, which is still taped behind the bar.

name: Priya Shenoy
blurb: Somehow the only person in the club who can explain a Tron mirror match without everyone's eyes glazing over. Hasn't lost on a league Monday all year, which the rest of us are getting a little tired of.

name: Declan Fitzwilliam
blurb: Been around since before we even moved venues the first time, and he's still running the same battered sleeves on his artifacts from back then.

name: Tomasz Wieczorek
blurb: Turned up for a one-off demo night years ago and just never left. Still holds the club record for most creatures cast in a single turn — fourteen, if you don't believe us.

name: Aoife Lundqvist
blurb: Doesn't say much during a match, but somehow ends up in the Autumn Championship final most years — three times now.
